title: Heart of the Wasteland
description: A fairy-like woman with butterfly wings and a golden crown stands in a cracked desert landscape, one hand touching a tall broken blue monolith oozing molten gold from a heart-shaped cavity. She holds a staff topped with a cow skull and flowers that reads "TO MY HEART" while a giant pink sun with clock hands and musical notes looms over a distant purple city.
prompt: A confident fairy woman with large butterfly wings, wearing a red bodysuit, green military jacket and boots, and a golden crown stands in a cracked desert wasteland. She touches a tall broken blue stone monolith that has a heart-shaped hole oozing molten gold. She holds a long staff topped with a cow skull, flowers and a banner saying TO MY HEART. Giant pink sun with clock hands and musical notes in the sky, purple city in the background, scattered melting clocks, pink jellyfish, bananas and eyeballs on the ground, surreal symbolic style.
